trigger: Only if the fixed final selected shared actor checkpoint has a confirmed nonfinite inference parameter or buffer. A bad score or poor trajectory never triggers recovery. The fixed primary endpoint remains the assigned primary outcome.
rule: Inspect only saved actors on the accepted development stream ancestry ending at its fixed terminal checkpoint, with the same tagged native schema, source bank, physics, canonical initialization and hybrid setting. Iterate strictly descending native environment steps, starting below the rejected selected terminal. Use the first native actor with all finite inference tensors. Do not inspect any development or held-out score for selection. No candidate means unavailable.
scope: One recovery alias per invalid shared method, registered and hashed before any held-out source is opened. A usable terminal primary produces no recovery alias or additional jobs.
adaptation: Score recovered actors zero-shot first. For each target independently transfer only its recovered actor and batch statistics into the common zero-step native learner, with an empty target replay and fresh critic. Hybrid's matched actor-only adaptation uses a fresh auxiliary model. Use the identical source-stage hashes, per-reference native budgets, physics, initialization seeds, curriculum, gates, repeated validation and stop rules as the fixed primary.
optional_dynamics: If desired, evaluate a distinct extra model-transfer comparison only with the exact auxiliary sidecar belonging to the recovered hybrid actor's checkpoint-set ID, step, native training state and source physics fingerprint. If unavailable, record this outcome, never select another actor or sidecar. Its zero-shot must reuse only that identical recovered actor's verified score.
cost: Charge the entire original shared-method development cost, including later failed or invalid steps and all failed attempts, plus measured CPU inspection/selection. Deduplicate original target intake, physics calibration and pretraining across the real experiment. Charge actual recovered target evaluations and adaptation; retain all three assignments when recovery is unavailable.
